## `set_project_analyst`

*Available in [Python](#set_project_analyst-python), [CLI](#set_project_analyst-cli)*
=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    Sets the project analyst field of a CIDA project.
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    set_project_analyst(
        analyst: str | list[str] | None,
        project: CIDAProject = None
    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `analyst` (`str | list[str] | None`) - The new value for the analyst field. If none is specified, uses the value of `current_project()`.
    - `project` (`CIDAProject`) - The CIDA project to set the analyst for. If none is specified, uses the value of `current_project()`.

    <h4>Returns `None`</h4>

    None
